scripts.predev: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @nbs-crm/shared
scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev -w @nbs-crm/shared" "npm run dev -w @nbs-crm/web" "npm run dev -w @nbs-crm/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nbs-crm/shared && npm run build -w @nbs-crm/api && npm run build -w @nbs-crm/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @nbs-crm/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
